entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I hope you can help. I bought this Aero Road helmet, but I need to return it and I'm just... I'm so confused by the website. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF-774-2981. It all seems so complicated. Can't you just help me figure this out?

Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me pull up that order... I see it right here. The Aero Road Helmet, delivered 26 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, there's nothing wrong with it! It's just... the color. It looked different online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.

I completely understand. Getting the right color and feel for your gear is very important, not just for style but for your overall safety and confidence on the road. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I've checked our policy, and you have nothing to worry about. Since the item was delivered 26 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? It is? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with a helmet I wouldn't use.

Not at all. I have just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. You just need to print that, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow. That's... thank you so much, Diana. You made that so easy for me.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
